chat-hi.title: Hi / Hello
chat-hi.answer: Hello there! 👋 Welcome to BawaGo. I am BawaBot, your 24/7 AI guide to our 7 peer-to-peer services (Ride, Parcel, Baggage, Crave Food, Host, Wish, Fresh) and SafeVault Escrow.

chat-how-are-you.title: How are you?
chat-how-are-you.answer: I'm doing great and running at full speed! 🚀 Ready to help you travel cheaper, send packages safely, enjoy mom-made meals, or earn money along your daily commute. How can I assist you today?

chat-good-morning.title: Good morning
chat-good-morning.answer: Good morning! ☀️ Wishing you a wonderful and productive day ahead! Planning a daily commute, sending morning fresh produce, or ordering fresh breakfast tiffins? BawaGo is here to help.

chat-good-afternoon.title: Good afternoon
chat-good-afternoon.answer: Good afternoon! 🌤️ Hope your day is going smoothly. Need an afternoon parcel delivery, a quick ride across town, or a wholesome home-cooked lunch? Let me know what you need!

chat-good-evening.title: Good evening
chat-good-evening.answer: Good evening! 🌆 Heading home from work or planning inter-city weekend travel? BawaGo connects you with trusted verified neighbors and travelers along your route.

chat-good-night.title: Good night
chat-good-night.answer: Good night! 🌙 Rest well. Remember that BawaBot and our 24/7 highway emergency network are always active around the clock whenever you need us.

chat-who-are-you.title: Who are you?
chat-who-are-you.answer: I am BawaBot 🤖, the official AI virtual concierge for the BawaGo community platform. I am trained on all 7 BawaGo services, escrow workflows, and platform policies to give you instant, accurate help.

chat-what-can-you-do.title: What can you do?
chat-what-can-you-do.answer: I can guide you through every feature of BawaGo! From finding empty carpool seats and shipping packages to booking spare luggage allowance, homemade meals, unique homestays, custom souvenirs, and farm produce.

chat-thank-you.title: Thank you / Thanks
chat-thank-you.answer: You're very welcome! 😊 It is my absolute pleasure to help. Feel free to ask whenever you have questions about rides, food, deliveries, or payments.

chat-awesome.title: You are awesome / Great
chat-awesome.answer: Thank you so much! ✨ Our mission at BawaGo is to make peer-to-peer travel and community sharing effortless, secure, and affordable for everyone.

chat-bye.title: Goodbye / Bye
chat-bye.answer: Goodbye for now! 👋 Have a wonderful day ahead. Whenever you need a ride, parcel delivery, or home-cooked meal, BawaBot is just one tap away!

chat-are-you-real.title: Are you real or a bot?
chat-are-you-real.answer: I am an intelligent AI assistant built specifically for BawaGo! If you ever need human support for complex disputes or specific account escalations, our dedicated 24/7 human support team is also available.
chat-are-you-real.canonical_question: Are you real or a bot?

chat-joke.title: Tell me a joke
chat-joke.answer: Here's one for travelers! 😄 Why did the luggage never get lost? Because it had peer-to-peer baggage tracking and SafeVault Escrow protecting its every move! 🧳✨

chat-location.title: Where is BawaGo available?
chat-location.answer: BawaGo operates across major urban transit corridors, inter-city highways, and international flight routes in India, Southeast Asia (Indonesia, Vietnam, Thailand, Malaysia, Philippines), and expanding global corridors.

chat-what-is-bawago.title: What is BawaGo?
chat-what-is-bawago.answer: BawaGo is a decentralized peer-to-peer intermediary platform that connects individuals with empty journey capacity (seats, cargo space, extra luggage kilos, home cooking, spare rooms) directly with people who need them.

acc-signup.title: How do I create an account on BawaGo?
acc-signup.answer: Signing up is quick and free! Click the 'Get Started' or 'Sign In' button at the top of any page, enter your mobile phone number or email, and verify with a secure one-time password (OTP).
acc-signup.canonical_question: How do I create an account on BawaGo?

acc-free.title: Is BawaGo free to use?
acc-free.answer: Yes! Creating an account and browsing opportunities on BawaGo is 100% free with zero monthly subscription fees. You only pay for the specific services you book, with complete upfront pricing.

acc-login.title: How do I log in?
acc-login.answer: Click the 'Sign In' button on the top navigation bar. Enter your registered email address or mobile number, then input your password or request an instant login OTP.

acc-reset-pass.title: How do I reset my password?
acc-reset-pass.answer: On the login screen, click 'Forgot Password?'. Enter your registered email or phone number. We will send a secure verification code and a link to reset your password safely.
acc-reset-pass.canonical_question: How do I reset my password?

acc-language.title: How do I change the website language?
acc-language.answer: Click the language selector globe icon 🌐 in the top navigation bar. BawaGo supports 35+ global and regional Indian languages including Hindi, Bengali, Telugu, Marathi, Tamil, Urdu, Gujarati, Kannada, Spanish, French, and Bahasa.
acc-language.canonical_question: How do I change the website language?

acc-theme.title: How do I switch between Dark and Light mode?
acc-theme.answer: You can toggle themes or customize your interface colors via the theme settings in the top navigation bar or under your account settings. Choose between sleek dark mode or crisp light mode.
acc-theme.canonical_question: How do I switch between Dark and Light mode?

acc-update-profile.title: How do I update my profile details?
acc-update-profile.answer: Go to your Account Dashboard by clicking on your avatar at the top right, then select 'Settings' or 'Profile'. Here you can update your name, photo, bio, emergency contacts, and notification preferences.
acc-update-profile.canonical_question: How do I update my profile details?

acc-delete.title: How do I delete or close my account?
acc-delete.answer: You can request account deactivation from Dashboard > Settings > Security. Please ensure all active bookings are completed and any remaining BawaGo Wallet balance has been withdrawn to your bank first.
acc-delete.canonical_question: How do I delete or close my account?

ride-booking.title: How do I book a ride on BawaGo?
ride-booking.answer: Go to the BawaGo Ride page (/ride). Enter your pickup point, drop location, journey date, and number of passengers. Browse available verified drivers and shared carpools, select your preferred vehicle, and confirm your booking.
ride-booking.canonical_question: How do I book a ride on BawaGo?

ride-vehicle-types.title: What types of vehicles are available on BawaGo Ride?
ride-vehicle-types.answer: BawaGo Ride supports multiple vehicle classes: Bikes (fast single commuter trips), Cars/Sedans (daily city commutes), SUVs (family & highway trips), MPVs/Vans (group travel), and Tempos (small commercial cargo).
ride-vehicle-types.canonical_question: What types of vehicles are available on BawaGo Ride?

ride-fare.title: How is the ride fare calculated?
ride-fare.answer: Carpooling fares are calculated based on distance, route fuel-sharing formulas, and vehicle class. Because drivers are offsetting existing travel costs rather than operating traditional taxi monopolies, fares are up to 60% cheaper.
ride-fare.canonical_question: How is the ride fare calculated?

ride-schedule.title: Can I schedule a ride in advance?
ride-schedule.answer: Yes! You can schedule rides minutes, days, or even weeks in advance. Inter-city carpools are frequently posted well ahead of time by drivers planning regular weekend or holiday trips.
ride-schedule.canonical_question: Can I schedule a ride in advance?

ride-share-tracking.title: Can I share live ride tracking with my family?
ride-share-tracking.answer: Yes! Every BawaGo Ride comes with real-time GPS tracking. You can share a secure live trip link with family or friends via WhatsApp or SMS so they can monitor your route and ETA in real time.
ride-share-tracking.canonical_question: Can I share live ride tracking with my family?

ride-driver-late.title: What if my driver is late or does not show up?
ride-driver-late.answer: If a driver fails to arrive at the agreed pickup point or cancels last minute, you can cancel with zero penalty. SafeVault Escrow instantly refunds 100% of your funds to your BawaGo Wallet, and our matching engine suggests alternative rides.
ride-driver-late.canonical_question: What if my driver is late or does not show up?

ride-cancellation-policy.title: What is the cancellation policy for rides?
ride-cancellation-policy.answer: You can cancel a ride anytime from your dashboard. Cancellations made more than 2 hours prior to scheduled departure receive a full 100% refund. Late cancellations may incur a nominal compensation fee for the driver.
ride-cancellation-policy.canonical_question: What is the cancellation policy for rides?

ride-insurance.title: Are rides insured on BawaGo?
ride-insurance.answer: Yes. Every verified passenger ride on BawaGo is covered by comprehensive third-party transit insurance in partnership with leading underwriters, providing accidental medical coverage and personal indemnity.

ride-offer-seats.title: How do I offer empty seats as a driver?
ride-offer-seats.answer: Click 'Offer Your Capacity' > 'Ride' on the homepage or provider portal. Enter your starting point, destination, date, available seats, and suggested cost share per seat. Verified commuters can then book seats with you.
ride-offer-seats.canonical_question: How do I offer empty seats as a driver?

ride-driver-verification.title: How are drivers verified on BawaGo?
ride-driver-verification.answer: All drivers must upload a valid government driving license, vehicle registration certificate (RC), active vehicle insurance, and pass government photo ID (Aadhaar / Passport) verification before offering rides.
ride-driver-verification.canonical_question: How are drivers verified on BawaGo?

ride-intercity.title: Can I book inter-city rides between different states?
ride-intercity.answer: Yes! BawaGo specializes in inter-city highway corridors (e.g., Mumbai-Pune, Bangalore-Chennai, Delhi-Jaipur, Jakarta-Bandung). Booking long-distance carpools saves money and reduces highway carbon emissions.
ride-intercity.canonical_question: Can I book inter-city rides between different states?

ride-sos.title: What is the Highway Emergency SOS button?
ride-sos.answer: During any active ride, a prominent red 'Emergency SOS' button is visible on your screen. Tapping it instantly shares your live coordinates with local emergency dispatchers, your designated emergency contacts, and nearby highway breakdown garages.
ride-sos.canonical_question: What is the Highway Emergency SOS button?

parcel-send.title: How do I send a parcel on BawaGo?
parcel-send.answer: Visit /parcel, enter the pickup and delivery addresses, choose package category (Documents, Gifts, Electronics, Goods), specify weight, and submit. You'll be matched with travelers heading in that exact direction for same-day express delivery.
parcel-send.canonical_question: How do I send a parcel on BawaGo?

parcel-items-allowed.title: What items can I send via BawaGo Parcel?
parcel-items-allowed.answer: You can send documents, contracts, books, packaged clothes, gifts, non-perishable packaged goods, and personal belongings. Every parcel is subject to mutual visual inspection before handover.
parcel-items-allowed.canonical_question: What items can I send via BawaGo Parcel?

parcel-prohibited.title: What items are strictly prohibited in parcels?
parcel-prohibited.answer: Strictly forbidden items include: hazardous materials, flammable liquids, explosives, weapons, illegal substances, contraband, unsealed perishable items, and currency notes. Violations lead to immediate account termination and police reporting.
parcel-prohibited.canonical_question: What items are strictly prohibited in parcels?

parcel-tracking.title: How do I track my parcel in real time?
parcel-tracking.answer: Once the traveler picks up your parcel and enters the pickup OTP, you will see a live map with real-time GPS tracking of the carrier's movement directly on your BawaGo Parcel dashboard.
parcel-tracking.canonical_question: How do I track my parcel in real time?

parcel-otp.title: What is Parcel OTP verification?
parcel-otp.answer: BawaGo uses a 2-step OTP security system: A Pickup OTP confirms the carrier received the package from the sender, and a Delivery OTP is provided by the recipient upon safe delivery. Only after Delivery OTP entry is escrow payment released.

parcel-insured.title: Is my parcel insured against damage or loss?
parcel-insured.answer: Yes! Every standard parcel booked on BawaGo is protected by SafeVault Transit Cover against accidental damage, theft, or loss up to standard declaration limits. Enhanced value coverage is available for high-value items.
parcel-insured.canonical_question: Is my parcel insured against damage or loss?

parcel-returning-empty.title: What is returning-empty cargo capacity?
parcel-returning-empty.answer: Many commercial vans, tempos, and private vehicles return empty after delivering goods. BawaGo matches senders with these 'returning empty' vehicles, cutting transport costs by up to 50% while helping drivers monetize deadhead miles.

parcel-earn.title: Can I earn money by delivering parcels along my commute?
parcel-earn.answer: Yes! If you travel between cities or commute across town daily, you can register as a verified carrier on BawaGo Parcel. Accept packages going in your direction and earn income without going out of your way.
parcel-earn.canonical_question: Can I earn money by delivering parcels along my commute?

parcel-weight-limit.title: What is the maximum weight and dimensions for parcels?
parcel-weight-limit.answer: Bike carriers typically accept up to 5-10 kg. Car and SUV carriers take up to 30 kg, while commercial tempos and returning-empty vans can handle bulk goods up to several hundred kilograms depending on listed capacity.
parcel-weight-limit.canonical_question: What is the maximum weight and dimensions for parcels?

parcel-cancellation.title: Can I cancel a parcel pickup request?
parcel-cancellation.answer: You can cancel a parcel request anytime before the carrier arrives for pickup. If cancelled before pickup, SafeVault Escrow automatically issues a 100% refund back to your BawaGo Wallet.
parcel-cancellation.canonical_question: Can I cancel a parcel pickup request?

baggage-overview.title: How does BawaGo Baggage allowance pooling work?
baggage-overview.answer: Baggage pooling lets travelers with spare flight luggage allowance share their unused kilos with senders who need affordable shipping. Senders save up to 60% compared to airline excess baggage rates, and travelers earn money on flights they were already taking!
baggage-overview.canonical_question: How does BawaGo Baggage allowance pooling work?

baggage-legal.title: Is luggage sharing legal and safe?
baggage-legal.answer: BawaGo Baggage strictly complies with international civil aviation guidelines: Both the ticketed traveler and item owner must meet at the departures terminal, visually inspect every item together, verify contents against customs rules, and seal the bag.
baggage-legal.canonical_question: Is luggage sharing legal and safe?

baggage-sell-kilos.title: How do I sell my unused flight baggage kilos?
baggage-sell-kilos.answer: If you have a flight ticket with 20kg or 30kg baggage allowance but only packed 10kg, you can list your spare kilos on BawaGo Baggage. Just enter your route, flight date, and available weight. Verified senders will book your space, and payments are protected in SafeVault.
baggage-sell-kilos.canonical_question: How do I sell my unused flight baggage kilos?

baggage-banned.title: What items are strictly banned in shared baggage?
baggage-banned.answer: For safety and airline compliance, passengers can only carry legal items that have been visually inspected in person. Strictly prohibited: illegal narcotics, weapons, unprescribed pharmaceuticals, undeclared cash or gold, and hazardous materials.
baggage-banned.canonical_question: What items are strictly banned in shared baggage?

baggage-handover.title: How do I collect my luggage at the destination airport?
baggage-handover.answer: The traveler collects the bag from the arrivals baggage carousel, proceeds through customs, and meets you at the designated arrivals terminal public meeting area. You inspect the bag, exchange the Delivery OTP, and complete handover.
baggage-handover.canonical_question: How do I collect my luggage at the destination airport?

baggage-flight-delay.title: What happens if a flight is delayed or cancelled?
baggage-flight-delay.answer: BawaGo tracks flight radar automatically. If a flight is delayed, estimated handover times update in real-time. If an airline cancels the flight and travel does not occur, escrow returns full funds to the sender.
baggage-flight-delay.canonical_question: What happens if a flight is delayed or cancelled?

baggage-train-bus.title: Can I pool baggage space on trains and buses?
baggage-train-bus.answer: Yes! Baggage pooling is also widely used by passengers traveling on high-speed rail, express trains, and inter-city bus networks where travelers have ample luggage compartment space.
baggage-train-bus.canonical_question: Can I pool baggage space on trains and buses?

baggage-savings.title: How much money can I save on excess baggage?
baggage-savings.answer: Airlines typically charge $20 to $50 per extra kilogram on international flights. On BawaGo, community peer rates are usually $5 to $15 per kilo, saving travelers up to 70% while putting earnings directly in travelers' pockets.
baggage-savings.canonical_question: How much money can I save on excess baggage?

baggage-documents.title: What documents are required for baggage pooling?
baggage-documents.answer: The traveler must provide proof of verified flight/train booking (PNR) and government photo ID. The sender must provide government ID, proof of item purchase/invoices where applicable, and signed item declaration.
baggage-documents.canonical_question: What documents are required for baggage pooling?

baggage-escrow.title: How does SafeVault Escrow protect baggage pooling?
baggage-escrow.answer: When a sender books baggage space, their payment is locked in SafeVault Escrow. The traveler only receives payment after safe handover at the destination airport when the sender provides the Delivery OTP.
baggage-escrow.canonical_question: How does SafeVault Escrow protect baggage pooling?
keywords: when does traveler get paid baggage

crave-how-it-works.title: How does BawaGo Crave home food work?
crave-how-it-works.answer: BawaGo Crave connects food lovers with passionate, verified home cooks in their neighborhood. Order authentic regional cuisines, daily tiffins, healthy meal boxes, and festive feasts prepared with fresh, hygienic home ingredients.
crave-how-it-works.canonical_question: How does BawaGo Crave home food work?

crave-become-cook.title: How do I register as a home cook on Crave?
crave-become-cook.answer: If you love cooking, register on Crave! Submit your kitchen photos, hygiene declaration, food safety certification (FSSAI/local safety permit), and your specialty menu. Set your own hours, pricing, and portion limits.
crave-become-cook.canonical_question: How do I register as a home cook on Crave?

crave-cuisines.title: What types of cuisines are available on Crave?
crave-cuisines.answer: You'll find diverse regional cuisines: North Indian, South Indian, Bengali, Maharashtrian, Gujarati, Indonesian, Thai, Vietnamese, Middle Eastern, as well as keto, diabetic-friendly, vegan, and traditional satvik menus.
crave-cuisines.canonical_question: What types of cuisines are available on Crave?

crave-hygiene.title: How does Crave ensure kitchen hygiene and food safety?
crave-hygiene.answer: All home cooks must provide statutory food handling compliance, pass kitchen cleanliness verification, and adhere to strict packaging guidelines. Community ratings and surprise audits maintain the highest hygiene standards.
crave-hygiene.canonical_question: How does Crave ensure kitchen hygiene and food safety?

crave-tiffin-subscription.title: Can I subscribe to daily tiffin or meal plans?
crave-tiffin-subscription.answer: Yes! Many home cooks offer weekly or monthly tiffin subscriptions for lunch and dinner. You can set your delivery schedule, pause deliveries during travel, and enjoy consistent home-cooked nourishment.
crave-tiffin-subscription.canonical_question: Can I subscribe to daily tiffin or meal plans?

crave-customization.title: Can I customize dishes for spice levels or allergies?
crave-customization.answer: Yes! Because meals are prepared fresh in small home batches, you can leave custom notes for your cook—such as requesting low spice, no onion/garlic (Jain), gluten-free, or specific allergen exclusions.
crave-customization.canonical_question: Can I customize dishes for spice levels or allergies?

crave-preorder.title: Can I pre-order food for weekend parties or feasts?
crave-preorder.answer: Yes! Home cooks frequently accept pre-orders for weekend family gatherings, small office lunches, festive sweets, or traditional multi-course feasts with 24-48 hours advance notice.
crave-preorder.canonical_question: Can I pre-order food for weekend parties or feasts?

crave-delivery.title: How is Crave home food delivered hot and fresh?
crave-delivery.answer: Meals are packed in thermal containers and dispatched immediately upon cooking via BawaGo Parcel express community carriers or neighborhood delivery partners, ensuring food reaches you piping hot.
crave-delivery.canonical_question: How is Crave home food delivered hot and fresh?

crave-cook-payout.title: When do home cooks receive their payouts?
crave-cook-payout.answer: Upon successful OTP delivery confirmation, earnings are credited immediately to the home cook's BawaGo Wallet. Cooks can withdraw funds to their linked bank account anytime with zero delay.
crave-cook-payout.canonical_question: When do home cooks receive their payouts?

crave-cancellation.title: What is the cancellation policy for food orders?
crave-cancellation.answer: You can cancel with a full refund before the home cook starts meal preparation. Once cooking has begun, cancellations are subject to ingredients cost recovery. If an order cannot be fulfilled, full refund is credited immediately.
crave-cancellation.canonical_question: What is the cancellation policy for food orders?

host-overview.title: How do I book a stay or room on BawaGo Host?
host-overview.answer: Visit /host to browse verified spare bedrooms, heritage homestays, apartments, villas, and unique rural eco-stays. Filter by location, dates, amenities, and price. Book securely with SafeVault escrow protection.
host-overview.canonical_question: How do I book a stay or room on BawaGo Host?

host-list-space.title: How do I list my spare room or property on BawaGo Host?
host-list-space.answer: Click 'Offer Your Capacity' > 'Host'. Upload photos of your space, describe amenities (Wi-Fi, AC, kitchen, parking), set your nightly or monthly price, and specify house rules. Start welcoming verified guests worldwide.
host-list-space.canonical_question: How do I list my spare room or property on BawaGo Host?

host-types-of-spaces.title: What types of spaces can I host on BawaGo?
host-types-of-spaces.answer: You can list spare private rooms, entire apartments, heritage villas, farm stays, student rooms, or even secure dry storage capacity for travelers needing temporary luggage or inventory storage.
host-types-of-spaces.canonical_question: What types of spaces can I host on BawaGo?

host-guest-verification.title: How are guests verified before check-in?
host-guest-verification.answer: Every guest must complete mandatory government identity verification (Aadhaar, Passport, or National ID) and phone verification before requesting a booking. Hosts can view guest verification badges and past review history.
host-guest-verification.canonical_question: How are guests verified before check-in?

host-luggage-storage.title: Can I rent my space for temporary luggage storage?
host-luggage-storage.answer: Yes! BawaGo Host allows property owners and homemakers to monetize secure, dry space (closets, spare rooms, garages) for travelers wanting to store bags for a few hours, days, or weeks.
host-luggage-storage.canonical_question: Can I rent my space for temporary luggage storage?

host-payout.title: How and when do hosts get paid?
host-payout.answer: Guest payments are held in SafeVault Escrow. Payout is released to the host's BawaGo Wallet 24 hours after guest check-in, ensuring the guest verified the listing accurately matches description.
host-payout.canonical_question: How and when do hosts get paid?

host-house-rules.title: What house rules can hosts specify?
host-house-rules.answer: Hosts can configure custom rules: check-in/out times, smoking policies, pet allowances, quiet hours, kitchen access, and guest visitor policies. Guests must agree to these rules before booking.
host-house-rules.canonical_question: What house rules can hosts specify?

host-damage-protection.title: What happens in case of property damage?
host-damage-protection.answer: SafeVault supports host security deposits held during the stay. If accidental damage occurs, hosts can submit photo evidence within 48 hours for expedited claim reimbursement from the security deposit and host protection pool.
host-damage-protection.canonical_question: What happens in case of property damage?

host-monthly-stays.title: Can digital nomads or students book monthly stays?
host-monthly-stays.answer: Yes! Many BawaGo hosts offer discounted weekly and monthly rates for digital nomads, remote workers, interns, and students looking for comfortable homestays with reliable Wi-Fi and home meals.
host-monthly-stays.canonical_question: Can digital nomads or students book monthly stays?

host-checkin.title: How does check-in and key handover work?
host-checkin.answer: Hosts provide clear arrival instructions in the booking confirmation. Check-in is verified via in-person greeting, smart lock codes, or secure lockboxes. Both parties exchange a digital Check-in confirmation on the app.
host-checkin.canonical_question: How does check-in and key handover work?

wish-overview.title: What is BawaGo Wish custom sourcing?
wish-overview.answer: BawaGo Wish allows you to request unique items, regional sweets, handicrafts, fashion, or souvenirs from any city or country. A traveler heading to your city purchases and delivers it along their journey.
wish-overview.canonical_question: What is BawaGo Wish custom sourcing?

wish-create-request.title: How do I post a Wish request?
wish-create-request.answer: Go to /wish, specify the item name, origin city, reference photo or store link, target delivery date, item estimated price, and the traveler reward fee you are offering. Verified travelers visiting that city can accept your wish.
wish-create-request.canonical_question: How do I post a Wish request?

wish-traveler-earn.title: How can travelers earn by fulfilling Wish requests?
wish-traveler-earn.answer: When traveling, browse Wish requests originating from your destination city. If you're visiting a market or shopping area, accept the request, purchase the item, and bring it with you to earn the reward fee upon delivery.
wish-traveler-earn.canonical_question: How can travelers earn by fulfilling Wish requests?

wish-wrong-item.title: What if the traveler buys the wrong item?
wish-wrong-item.answer: Travelers must upload a purchase receipt and item photo before traveling. If the delivered item does not match your agreed specification or is damaged, you can reject the handover and receive a full escrow refund.
wish-wrong-item.canonical_question: What if the traveler buys the wrong item?

wish-sweets-spices.title: Can I wish for authentic regional sweets, spices, and snacks?
wish-sweets-spices.answer: Yes! This is one of the most popular uses of BawaGo Wish—getting authentic Hyderabadi Karachi biscuits, Kolkata sandesh, Varanasi silk scarves, Darjeeling tea, or Balinese spices brought fresh by travelers.
wish-sweets-spices.canonical_question: Can I wish for authentic regional sweets, spices, and snacks?

wish-international.title: Are international Wish requests supported?
wish-international.answer: Yes! International travelers frequently fulfill Wish requests for cosmetics, gadgets, snacks, or fashion from overseas within duty-free personal baggage limits. Commercial quantities requiring customs import licenses are prohibited.

wish-timeline.title: How fast is Wish fulfillment and delivery?
wish-timeline.answer: Fulfillment depends on traveler routes. On popular corridors (e.g., Delhi-Mumbai, Dubai-India, Singapore-Jakarta), wishes are often accepted within hours and delivered within 1 to 3 days.
wish-timeline.canonical_question: How fast is Wish fulfillment and delivery?

wish-escrow-security.title: How does escrow protect the traveler and the buyer in Wish?
wish-escrow-security.answer: SafeVault locks both the item cost and the reward fee upfront from the buyer. The traveler is guaranteed reimbursement upon delivery, while the buyer is guaranteed that funds are never paid out until they inspect the physical item.
wish-escrow-security.canonical_question: How does escrow protect the traveler and the buyer in Wish?

fresh-overview.title: How does BawaGo Fresh farm produce delivery work?
fresh-overview.answer: BawaGo Fresh connects agricultural producers and rural farm clusters directly with urban households along daily commuter transit corridors. Cut out predatory wholesale middlemen and enjoy morning-harvested produce.
fresh-overview.canonical_question: How does BawaGo Fresh farm produce delivery work?

fresh-origin.title: Where does BawaGo Fresh produce come from?
fresh-origin.answer: Produce comes from verified smallholder farmers, organic growers, and rural farm cooperatives located within 50-150 km of urban cities along active highway freight and commuter corridors.
fresh-origin.canonical_question: Where does BawaGo Fresh produce come from?

fresh-farmer-list.title: How do farmers list their harvest on BawaGo Fresh?
fresh-farmer-list.answer: Farmers or agricultural collectives list upcoming harvest dates, crop varieties (tomatoes, spinach, rice, mangoes, coconut), quantity in kilograms/crates, and price. Transit carriers pick up crates at highway collection hubs.
fresh-farmer-list.canonical_question: How do farmers list their harvest on BawaGo Fresh?

fresh-products.title: What farm products are available on Fresh?
fresh-products.answer: Fresh includes: seasonal vegetables (tomatoes, spinach, gourds), orchard fruits, heritage rice, whole pulses, farm-fresh eggs, artisanal dairy/ghee, cold-pressed oils, and fresh coconut products.
fresh-products.canonical_question: What farm products are available on Fresh?

fresh-bulk-housing.title: Can housing societies and apartments order in bulk?
fresh-bulk-housing.answer: Yes! BawaGo Fresh specializes in residential society group orders. Apartment communities pool weekly fruit and vegetable orders for bulk highway delivery, getting farm-gate wholesale prices with zero delivery surcharges.
fresh-bulk-housing.canonical_question: Can housing societies and apartments order in bulk?

fresh-transit-baskets.title: What are morning transit baskets?
fresh-transit-baskets.answer: Produce is packed in reusable aerated crates called Transit Baskets. Morning inter-city commuters or returning vans transport these baskets from rural highway pickup points directly into city drop hubs.

fresh-quality-guarantee.title: What if some fruits or vegetables are damaged?
fresh-quality-guarantee.answer: We offer a 100% Freshness Guarantee! If any item arrives bruised, spoiled, or damaged, snap a photo in the app within 4 hours of delivery. SafeVault Escrow automatically issues an instant replacement credit or refund.
fresh-quality-guarantee.canonical_question: What if some fruits or vegetables are damaged?

fresh-why-better.title: Why is BawaGo Fresh better than supermarkets?
fresh-why-better.answer: Supermarket produce spends 4-8 days in cold storage and distribution hubs before reaching shelves, losing flavor and nutrients. BawaGo Fresh produce is harvested at dawn and in your kitchen by afternoon.
fresh-why-better.canonical_question: Why is BawaGo Fresh better than supermarkets?

escrow-what-is.title: What is SafeVault Escrow and how does it work?
escrow-what-is.answer: SafeVault Escrow is BawaGo's automated financial trust layer. When you book any service, your payment is held safely in escrow. The provider is NEVER paid upfront. Funds are only released when you confirm satisfactory service with an OTP.
escrow-what-is.canonical_question: What is SafeVault Escrow and how does it work?

escrow-payment-methods.title: What payment methods are supported on BawaGo?
escrow-payment-methods.answer: BawaGo supports all major secure payment channels: UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), Credit & Debit Cards (Visa, Mastercard, RuPay), NetBanking (all major banks), and your integrated BawaGo Digital Wallet.
escrow-payment-methods.canonical_question: What payment methods are supported on BawaGo?

escrow-wallet-withdraw.title: How do I withdraw money from BawaGo Wallet to my bank?
escrow-wallet-withdraw.answer: Go to Dashboard > Wallet > 'Withdraw'. Enter the amount and select your linked bank account or UPI ID. Withdrawals are processed instantly via automated IMPS / UPI with zero transfer fees.
escrow-wallet-withdraw.canonical_question: How do I withdraw money from BawaGo Wallet to my bank?

escrow-refund-timeline.title: What is the refund process and timeline?
escrow-refund-timeline.answer: Refunds issued to your BawaGo Wallet are instantaneous (0 seconds). If you choose to refund back to your original source (credit card / bank), banking networks typically complete processing within 24 to 48 hours.
escrow-refund-timeline.canonical_question: What is the refund process and timeline?

escrow-fees.title: Are there any hidden fees or surprise charges on BawaGo?
escrow-fees.answer: BawaGo keeps pricing straightforward: we charge a transparent 5% to 10% platform fee (typically 7% for standard escrow). More than 90% of the total payment goes directly into the provider's wallet, and payouts can be withdrawn instantly to your bank account or UPI.
escrow-fees.canonical_question: Are there any hidden fees or surprise charges on BawaGo?

escrow-banking-security.title: Is my card and banking data secure?
escrow-banking-security.answer: Yes. BawaGo complies with global PCI-DSS Level 1 standards and RBI tokenization regulations. We do not store raw card numbers on our servers. All financial transactions are secured by tokenized 256-bit TLS encryption.
escrow-banking-security.canonical_question: Is my card and banking data secure?

escrow-failed-transaction.title: What happens if a payment fails but money was deducted?
escrow-failed-transaction.answer: Banking networks occasionally experience timeout glitches. If money was deducted, our automated reconciliation engine detects it and either completes your booking within 5 minutes or auto-refunds the amount back to your source account.
escrow-failed-transaction.canonical_question: What happens if a payment fails but money was deducted?

escrow-milestone-release.title: What is a milestone escrow release?
escrow-milestone-release.answer: For long-term arrangements like monthly homestays or multi-stage goods shipments, SafeVault breaks payments into milestones. Funds are released progressively as each phase (e.g. Week 1 check-in, mid-month) is validated.
escrow-milestone-release.canonical_question: What is a milestone escrow release?

escrow-cashless.title: Why does BawaGo recommend cashless escrow payments?
escrow-cashless.answer: Cash payments carry high risk: no record of payment, no dispute resolution, and no insurance coverage. SafeVault escrow provides a digital proof of transaction, automatic accidental insurance, and instant refund capability.
escrow-cashless.canonical_question: Why does BawaGo recommend cashless escrow payments?

escrow-dispute-resolution.title: How do I raise a payment dispute on BawaGo?
escrow-dispute-resolution.answer: If a service was unsatisfactory or unfulfilled, tap 'Dispute' on your booking screen before providing the OTP. Funds will remain locked in SafeVault while our dedicated resolution team reviews evidence from both parties.
escrow-dispute-resolution.canonical_question: How do I raise a payment dispute on BawaGo?

safety-kyc-process.title: What is the KYC verification process?
safety-kyc-process.answer: KYC verification takes under 2 minutes: Go to Profile > 'Verify Identity'. Upload a clear photo of your government ID (Aadhaar, Passport, Driving License, or KTP) and take a quick selfie to verify biometric match.
safety-kyc-process.canonical_question: What is the KYC verification process?

safety-id-documents.title: Which government ID documents are accepted for KYC?
safety-id-documents.answer: Accepted IDs include: Government National Identity (Aadhaar, e-Aadhaar, KTP, MyKad), International Passport, Driver's License, or Voter ID. Documents must be valid, unexpired, and clearly legible.
safety-id-documents.canonical_question: Which government ID documents are accepted for KYC?

safety-emergency-guardian.title: How does the Emergency Guardian feature work?
safety-emergency-guardian.answer: Emergency Guardian allows you to designate trusted contacts (family, spouse, close friends). During any trip or delivery, your Guardian can track your live GPS route, battery status, and receive alerts if an SOS is triggered.
safety-emergency-guardian.canonical_question: How does the Emergency Guardian feature work?

safety-breakdown-garage.title: What is Highway Breakdown & Garage Assistance?
safety-breakdown-garage.answer: BawaGo partners with 2,500+ verified automotive garages and towing services along national highway corridors. If your vehicle breaks down during a ride, open Emergency Guardian to connect with nearby mechanical assistance.
safety-breakdown-garage.canonical_question: What is Highway Breakdown & Garage Assistance?

safety-community-ratings.title: How do reviews and trust ratings keep users safe?
safety-community-ratings.answer: Every completed transaction requires mutual star ratings and written reviews. Users maintaining ratings below 4.2 stars are flagged for review, and bad actors are permanently suspended from the network.
safety-community-ratings.canonical_question: How do reviews and trust ratings keep users safe?

safety-report-user.title: How do I report a suspicious user or inappropriate behavior?
safety-report-user.answer: Tap the three-dot menu on any user profile or chat conversation and select 'Report User'. Specify the reason (harassment, off-platform payment demand, suspicious behavior). Our trust and safety team investigates immediately.
safety-report-user.canonical_question: How do I report a suspicious user or inappropriate behavior?

safety-women-travelers.title: What safety features are available for women travelers?
safety-women-travelers.answer: BawaGo provides dedicated safety features for women: 'Women-Only' carpool matching options, verified female driver preferences, discreet 1-tap SOS triggers, and prioritized 24/7 emergency response handling.
safety-women-travelers.canonical_question: What safety features are available for women travelers?

safety-data-privacy.title: How does BawaGo protect my personal data and privacy?
safety-data-privacy.answer: We strictly adhere to data privacy standards. BawaGo never sells your personal phone number, identity documents, or journey data to third-party advertisers. Contact details are masked during bookings for privacy.
safety-data-privacy.canonical_question: How does BawaGo protect my personal data and privacy?

earn-how-to-start.title: How can I earn money on BawaGo?
earn-how-to-start.answer: Anyone can monetize existing journeys or resources! Offer carpool seats on daily drives, deliver packages along your route, share excess flight baggage kilos, cook home meals, or list spare bedrooms.
earn-how-to-start.canonical_question: How can I earn money on BawaGo?

earn-who-can-join.title: Who can become a service provider on BawaGo?
earn-who-can-join.answer: Anyone aged 18+ with a valid government ID and appropriate assets (a car, empty flight ticket, kitchen, spare room, or willingness to courier) can join. It is ideal for daily commuters, homemakers, freelancers, and students.
earn-who-can-join.canonical_question: Who can become a service provider on BawaGo?

earn-multiple-services.title: Can I offer multiple services at once?
earn-multiple-services.answer: Yes! A single driver can offer carpool seats and carry lightweight parcels in their car boot at the same time, maximizing journey earnings. A homemaker can offer delicious meals on Crave and list a spare room on Host.
earn-multiple-services.canonical_question: Can I offer multiple services at once?
keywords: earn from both ride and parcel

earn-commission-rate.title: How much commission does BawaGo charge providers?
earn-commission-rate.answer: BawaGo charges an industry-low platform maintenance fee of just 5% to 10% (compared to 25-35% charged by traditional ride-hailing and food delivery monopolies), leaving 90%+ of earnings directly with providers.
earn-commission-rate.canonical_question: How much commission does BawaGo charge providers?

earn-payout-timing.title: When and how do service providers get paid?
earn-payout-timing.answer: Payments are credited to your BawaGo Wallet immediately upon completion of the service (Delivery OTP entry or trip end). You can initiate instant bank withdrawal anytime with 0-minute turnaround.
earn-payout-timing.canonical_question: When and how do service providers get paid?

earn-boost-bookings.title: How do I get more bookings and higher ratings as a provider?
earn-boost-bookings.answer: To maximize bookings: complete your profile with photos, maintain prompt communication in chat, be punctual, keep your vehicle/kitchen spotless, and deliver with a friendly smile to earn 5-star reviews.
earn-boost-bookings.canonical_question: How do I get more bookings and higher ratings as a provider?

earn-tax-compliance.title: How do taxes work on BawaGo earnings?
earn-tax-compliance.answer: BawaGo provides automated annual earnings statements and transaction ledgers on your dashboard. Providers are responsible for declaring personal earnings in accordance with their local income tax regulations.
earn-tax-compliance.canonical_question: How do taxes work on BawaGo earnings?

earn-equipment-needs.title: Do I need special equipment to start earning?
earn-equipment-needs.answer: No special commercial equipment is needed! All you need is a smartphone with the BawaGo app, your verified government identity, and your existing vehicle, kitchen, luggage space, or room.

support-contact-channels.title: How do I contact customer support?
support-contact-channels.answer: You can reach our support team 24/7 via in-app Help Center (/help), email us at contact@bawago.com, or fill out the contact form on our Contact Us page (/contact). For emergencies, use the 1-Tap SOS button.
support-contact-channels.canonical_question: How do I contact customer support?

support-email.title: What is BawaGo’s official support email address?
support-email.answer: Our official customer support and assistance email address is contact@bawago.com. For business and enterprise inquiries, reach out to partners@bawago.com.
support-email.canonical_question: What is BawaGo’s official support email address?

support-app-troubleshoot.title: The website or app is not loading properly. What should I do?
support-app-troubleshoot.answer: First, refresh the page or clear your browser cache. Ensure you have an active internet connection. If the issue persists, try switching browsers or contacting support@bawago.com with a screenshot of the error.
support-app-troubleshoot.canonical_question: The website or app is not loading properly. What should I do?

support-human-agent.title: Can I speak with a human support agent?
support-human-agent.answer: Yes! While BawaBot handles immediate guides and answers, our human support executives are available 24/7. Simply submit a query through our Contact page or email support@bawago.com and an agent will assist you.

support-terms-privacy.title: Where can I read BawaGo’s Terms of Service and Privacy Policy?
support-terms-privacy.answer: Our legal terms, user agreements, and privacy policies are accessible anytime at the footer of our website via /terms and /privacy, outlining user responsibilities, escrow rules, and data rights.

support-safety-guidelines.title: Where can I review community safety guidelines?
support-safety-guidelines.answer: Our complete safety protocols and community code of conduct are detailed at /safety. They cover ID verification standards, package inspection protocols, emergency procedures, and dispute mediation.

support-feedback.title: How do I share feedback or feature suggestions?
support-feedback.answer: We love hearing from our community! You can share feature suggestions, feedback, or ideas directly through the Contact Us page or by emailing feedback@bawago.com. Many of our best features came from user suggestions!
support-feedback.canonical_question: How do I share feedback or feature suggestions?

support-offline.title: Does BawaBot work offline?
support-offline.answer: BawaBot runs directly inside your browser with a localized client-side knowledge base! Basic question-and-answer guides remain accessible even with intermittent connectivity once the page is loaded.

baggage-laptop-electronics.title: Can I carry a laptop or electronics on a flight?
baggage-laptop-electronics.answer: Yes, you can carry a laptop or electronic gadget! Airlines require all laptops, tablets, and lithium-powered devices to be carried in your cabin hand-carry luggage—never in checked baggage. For safety and customs clearance, the sender must provide an original purchase invoice, and the device should power on during your mutual airport inspection.
baggage-laptop-electronics.canonical_question: Can I carry a laptop or electronic device on my flight?

corridors-routes.title: What are the most popular travel routes and corridors?
corridors-routes.answer: BawaGo operates across major domestic and international corridors! Top routes include Hyderabad to Dubai, Singapore to London, Delhi to Mumbai, Jakarta to Bali, and intercity highway carpools like Mumbai to Pune and Delhi to Jaipur. You can find active travelers flying or driving daily across these routes.
corridors-routes.canonical_question: What travel routes and corridors are available on BawaGo?

escrow-otp-delivery.title: Why do I need a 6-digit OTP code for delivery?
escrow-otp-delivery.answer: The 6-digit OTP is your personal release key for SafeVault Escrow. When you receive and inspect your item at handover, you share this secret code with the traveler or driver. Entering the OTP securely validates that the service was completed safely and unlocks their payout.
escrow-otp-delivery.canonical_question: Why do I need a 6-digit OTP to confirm delivery?

safety-insurance-guarantee.title: Is my package insured against loss or damage?
safety-insurance-guarantee.answer: Yes! Every booking completed through SafeVault is protected by the BawaGo Trust Guarantee at no extra cost. This provides up to $500 in loss and damage coverage for verified items during transit. If an accidental issue occurs, our support team handles the claim and reimburses you promptly.
safety-insurance-guarantee.canonical_question: Does BawaGo provide insurance and damage protection?

support-human-help.title: How do I contact human customer support?
support-human-help.answer: You can connect with our human customer care team anytime! We provide 24/7 support for booking disputes, claims, and urgent inquiries. You can email us at support@bawago.com or tap 'Raise Support Ticket' inside your app profile for assistance within 2 hours.
